entry.text: Project: DFS GEMINI App Support Service
Technologies: SAP SD/MM and basics of FICO Modules
Role: Associate (SAP MDM Consultant - MM)

projects.name: Project Description
details: Worked on ticketing tools SPIRIT by handling various types of Issues raised by USER’s and analysed Root cause by understanding the data flow and provided resolution.

Worked on Retail domain in Sales module performing reconciliation by analysing Sales variance (difference) issues raised by Client by understanding the flow of sales across various systems where sales flow is from 3rd party systems to SAP.
Configured new location/site/plant mapping in SAP using Tcode – SPRO based on user requirements and expertise in SAP tables Fields ABAP Query: Simple Reports and Debugging.
Extensively worked on GL mapping configurations and reconciliation of Ledger balances.
Worked on failed IDOC by resolving the error and reprocessing, communicating INBOUND OUTBOUND in between SAP R/3 system and middleware applications to interface missing or incorrect data.
Good knowledge on TR movements from quality to production systems worked on Change requests.
Responsible for preparing SOP for various issues reported by client for future knowledge and provided KT to fellow team members.
Maintained good communication with business user’s in understanding the issue and provided required resolution.
Creating LSMW for various mass upload of master data(Material, Vendor & Customer master).
Creation of SQVI by combining different tables for data extraction.
Solving Intercompany imbalance issues raised due to manual interventions in the regular process flow.
Having good knowledge in pricing procedure techniques(Configured and mapped GL to condition type based on retail/discount/tax components, Mapping material to condition type) by using SPRO tcode.
Co-ordination with various teams to reach to a resolution of an issue and executing the needed changes in configuration.

entry.text: Project: Mylan I-Viatris ERP Integration Data Migration
Technologies: SAP ABAP Program method and LSMW.
Role: Programmer Analyst (Data Migration consultant)

projects.name: Project Description
details: Followed phased approach for transferring data between (multiple) systems based on a specific migration methodology (i.e, ABAP Tcode method of transferring data and LSMW method).
Creation of SQVI by combining different tables for data extraction.
Developed LSMW templates to load material and vendor master data from non SAP system into SAP.
Conducted prechecks to avoid any complications during migration process by comparison of data stored in standard tables in SAP for Material and Vendor Data.

Later stage post loading we conducted a solid and extensive data reconciliation framework (Verification phase) including checks and balances is of crucial importance to verify the completeness and accuracy of the migrated data against original source data.

Conducted MTC (Mylan Testing Centre) run in which I have submitted the snapshots and required files after performing a data migration activity involving loading of Material and Vendor Master data into SAP Production system which is further verified by testing team.
Achieved Go-Live dates and provided post Go-live support by engaging with clients and provided support in developing cutover activities.
Responsible for creation of Material master data using ABAP transaction Method and Vendor Master data using LSMW Method.

Contributed for Data Migration Cutover Planning activity for Various Country-wise releases which helped in better interaction with Business and Local SME to get Input in building and completing the Planning Documents Involving Various Data Objects in Various Process Areas (PTP/PTS, OTC, RTR etc.)
